title: Project Portfolio Tracker
subtitle: Build a live-looking RAG portfolio dashboard that tells leadership exactly where to focus.
ai_tool: Any AI tool (Claude, Copilot, Cursor, Gemini)

data_files.role: Genpact APAC Client Delivery — 10 projects shown, RAG status (Green/Amber/Red), $8.2M revenue at risk, budget consumed %, milestone status, top risks and client satisfaction scores

learning_objectives: Choose a stack that makes RAG status impossible to miss — a Red project must look Red before you read a word
Read a portfolio file and identify the two critical escalations before writing a single prompt
Validate that your prompt names P003 and P010 explicitly and specifies what the Red indicators must show
Build a portfolio tracker that lets a VP run a 15-minute leadership review without PowerPoint
Deliver a dashboard that surfaces $8.2M revenue at risk in the first 10 seconds of viewing
deliverable: Single-file interactive HTML project portfolio dashboard
